title: Milestone, Birthday and Referral Bonus Schedule for the Wanderlane Traveller Club
content:
This schedule sets out the bonuses of spendable points the Wanderlane Traveller Club awards outside the ordinary earn rate. The milestone threshold is the number of tier-qualifying points at which a milestone bonus is paid within a period, and the milestone bonus is the number of spendable points paid when that threshold is reached. The birthday bonus is the number of spendable points paid once a year on the member's birthday. The referral bonus is the number of spendable points paid for each new member referred and enrolled, and the referral cap is the largest number of referrals that may be paid in one calendar year.

## The schedule

| Basis | Blue | Silver | Gold | Platinum | Titanium | Ambassador |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Milestone threshold (qualifying points) | 0 | 20000 | 40000 | 80000 | 140000 | 250000 |
| Milestone bonus (spendable points) | 0 | 2500 | 7500 | 15000 | 30000 | 60000 |
| Birthday bonus (spendable points) | 0 | 500 | 1000 | 2500 | 5000 | 10000 |
| Referral bonus (spendable points) | 500 | 1000 | 2000 | 3000 | 5000 | 8000 |
| Referral cap (referrals in a calendar year) | 3 | 5 | 8 | 12 | 20 | 40 |

## Notes

At Wanderlane Blue the milestone threshold, the milestone bonus and the birthday bonus all stand at 0; the referral bonus stands at 500 spendable points and the referral cap at 3 referrals in a calendar year, so the referral bonus is the one bonus on this schedule that Wanderlane Blue carries.

The milestone threshold and the milestone bonus rise together, from 20000 qualifying points against 2500 spendable points at Wanderlane Silver to 250000 qualifying points against 60000 spendable points at Wanderlane Ambassador.
